tasks.short: Verify research resources are used as planned

steps.what: Read and verify the actual approved research resource plan, project scope and financial, physical and staffing allocations
inputs: Actual approved project resource plan and allocations
outputs: Checked resource-plan comparison basis

steps.what: Receive and verify actual expenditure, inventory and staffing-use records and capture non-system resource-use exceptions
inputs: Actual finance, laboratory inventory and authorized staffing-use records
outputs: Checked actual-use inputs with project identifiers and captured exceptions

steps.what: Match actual resource-use lines to approved project allocations and compute exact variances under the supplied plan rules
outputs: Source-linked resource variance table and unmatched-item exceptions

steps.what: Investigate actual deviations and verify whether financial, physical and human resources were used as planned, including justified changes and unresolved issues
inputs: Actual variance table and source records
Approved project changes and actual colleague explanations
outputs: Scientist-verified findings on resource use

steps.what: Enter and check the actual resource-review findings in the existing project review record using linked project and allocation fields
inputs: Existing project identifiers and approved allocations
outputs: Final checked project resource-review record

steps.what: Save the final checked resource-review record in the same project system
outputs: Saved resource-use verification record

tasks.design: Configure exact plan-to-actual matching in {SPREADSHEET} from checked {ERP}, {OPS_SYSTEM} and {HCM} inputs, then record actual findings in {PROJECT}. The scientist investigates deviations and checks the final review record before saving it; no resource decision or personnel inference is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated allocation matching and copying project fields into review records can add administrative effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing project identifiers and approved variance rules can support deterministic comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Whether an apparent deviation reflects a legitimate project change or inaccurate records.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist understands how actual resource use relates to the research plan.

ambition.what: Reduce mechanical resource reconciliation within actual project reviews.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; finance, laboratory and personnel owners approve project-level access and applicable staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project resource records can be matched to approved allocations by exact identifiers and variance rules.

assumptions: Finance, laboratory and personnel owners supply actual-use records and the project owner supplies approved allocations; s2 checks completeness and captures real non-system exceptions. No clean time or inventory feed is assumed free.
Missing project identifiers, absent approvals or unreconciled totals stop affected comparisons for manual investigation. No model judges staff performance or reallocates resources.
This episode already requires a project resource-review record; it does not add a report after every informal check.
s3 replaces currently manual matching; equivalent existing comparisons earn no new gain. Illustrative gross saving 27.8 per 100 task hours, upkeep 3, net 24.8; same-system save earns none.
unknowns: Actual manual resource matching and authorized staffing-data access
research_questions: Which actual-use fields can already be matched to project allocations without retyping?

already_counted.description: Verify source inputs, investigate deviations and capture and check actual review findings

incremental.description: Maintain approved project and resource mappings and review reconciliation failures

approvals.approved_version: Complete resource-review record checked in s5; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured required project-review episode with manual plan-to-actual matching today; actual source capture and deviation judgment retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Receive and check actual market and customer-research records and capture the actual product-development question and source limitations
inputs: Actual existing customer-research and commercial records
outputs: Checked market inputs and explicit comparison criteria

steps.what: Map and aggregate checked market records into the specified comparison tables with source-linked counts and categories
inputs: Checked market records and explicit comparison criteria from s1
outputs: Draft market comparison tables and mapping exceptions

steps.what: Perform the actual market analysis, check source limitations and propose a justified bioproduct concept with the development team
inputs: Actual market sources and comparison tables
outputs: Scientist-authored market interpretation and product proposal

steps.what: Design actual development experiments within the laboratory's approved scientific scope and existing review process
inputs: Actual product question and scientific evidence
outputs: Scientist-authored development experiment plans

steps.what: Perform the actual authorized development experiments and assess their actual outputs and deviations under approved laboratory procedures
inputs: Actual authorized plans, samples and laboratory resources
outputs: Actual development findings and observed deviations

steps.what: Collaborate with actual operations and quality-control teams on development findings and launch-readiness issues within existing decision rights
outputs: Agreed development actions and unresolved launch issues

steps.what: Write and check the actual scientific development contribution and agreed actions in the existing project record
inputs: Actual findings, market interpretation and agreed actions
outputs: Final checked development contribution record

steps.what: Save the final checked contribution record in the same project workspace
outputs: Saved scientific development contribution

tasks.design: Configure exact market-record comparison tables in {SPREADSHEET} from checked {CRM} and {DOCS} sources. The scientist retains product proposals, market interpretation, experimental design and execution and launch collaboration, and records and checks the actual contribution in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manually mapping and assembling existing market records can add handling effort before actual analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing structured market records and approved categories can be compared deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: A useful product concept, credible scientific evidence, feasible development and real launch readiness.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist connects actual user needs, evidence and operational constraints.

ambition.what: Reduce bounded market-data handling within actual bioproduct development participation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; commercial, laboratory and project owners approve actual source access and development boundaries

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit market-data mappings can assemble comparison tables while product judgment, experimental work and launch collaboration remain human.

assumptions: Actual commercial and customer-research producers supply existing records; their research and data-collection work remains counted in the producing workflows. s1 checks actual coverage and source limitations and captures the scientist's comparison criteria.

No new market research, product performance, experimental result or laboratory method is generated for free. Missing categories and source conflicts stop affected comparisons for actual investigation in s3.

s2 replaces current repeated manual table assembly, not an existing equivalent report. All experimental work stays within the laboratory's actual authorized process; no operating parameter or biological design is supplied by the software.
Saving the scientific contribution does not approve a product launch or release a quality decision; actual launch authority remains with the responsible teams.
Illustrative gross saving 15 per 100 task hours, upkeep 3, net 12. Actual laboratory records shared with tasks 16807 or 16813 are counted once, and the same-workspace save earns no gain.
unknowns: Actual development-stage time mix and current manual market-data assembly
research_questions: Which market comparison inputs are actually reclassified and copied by the scientist today?

already_counted.description: Check actual market inputs, interpret comparisons and write and check the actual development contribution

incremental.description: Maintain approved market categories and inspect source-mapping exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Final scientific development contribution checked in s7; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured development-participation scenario; only actual repeated market-table assembly reduced, scientific and operational work retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with vendors on equipment and reagents

steps.what: Define and check actual user requirements and evaluation criteria for laboratory equipment, reagents or product-line customization
outputs: Scientist-authored vendor discussion and evaluation brief

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual vendor technical sheets, supplied compatibility information and prior evaluation records
outputs: Checked vendor information and open questions

steps.what: Confer with actual vendors to evaluate equipment or reagents and discuss customization against the real user requirements
inputs: Checked evaluation brief and technical information
outputs: Actual vendor answers, proposed options and unresolved evaluation questions

steps.what: Enter and check actual vendor answers and evaluation findings in the existing comparison form, keeping vendor claims distinct from tested findings
inputs: Actual discussion answers and scientist evaluation
Existing product identifiers and evaluation criteria
outputs: Final checked evaluation comparison record

steps.what: Save the final checked vendor-evaluation comparison in the same working document
outputs: Saved vendor-evaluation record

tasks.design: Configure actual vendor-document retrieval in {DOCS} and {PROCUREMENT} and reusable product fields in the existing evaluation form. The scientist sets requirements, conducts the discussion and captures and checks actual findings before saving the comparison.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical-sheet lookup and repeating product identifiers can add evaluation handling effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document indexes and comparison templates can reuse actual vendor metadata.
tasks.still_hard: Whether vendor claims meet actual laboratory needs and what customization is feasible.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist challenges vendor answers and judges their relevance to real users.

ambition.what: Reduce reference lookup and existing evaluation-record fields.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; laboratory and procurement owners approve source and evaluation-record access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: vendor-document indexes and product-linked evaluation forms can reduce repeated reference and identity handling.

assumptions: The scientist authors actual user requirements in s1, vendors supply actual technical sheets and s4 captures actual answers. Missing or unsupported vendor claims remain open questions rather than verified performance.
This episode already requires an equipment or reagent evaluation comparison, not new minutes after every vendor call.
No purchase order, customization commitment, sample request or external evaluation report is silently sent; live evaluation discussion does not authorize a purchase.
Illustrative gross saving 8.8 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1.5, net 7.3; existing equivalent document links earn no new gain and same-document saving earns none.
unknowns: Actual evaluation recording and technical-reference lookup effort
research_questions: Which current evaluation forms repeat vendor and product details already held by procurement?

already_counted.description: Check actual vendor sources and capture and check evaluation findings

incremental.description: Maintain vendor-product links and reusable evaluation fields

approvals.approved_version: Complete evaluation comparison checked in s4; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured actual evaluation episode; source navigation and repeated form fields reduced, actual discussion and judgment retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Elicit and check actual research database requirements, existing record categories, provenance, access boundaries and user queries
inputs: Actual research-user requirements and existing record dictionaries
outputs: Checked database requirements and data-governance constraints

steps.what: Design the actual database entities, fields, keys, relationships, provenance links and validation constraints for the existing research records
inputs: Checked actual requirements and existing record dictionary
outputs: Scientist-authored database schema specification and test cases

steps.what: Generate exact draft schema definitions and dictionary documentation from the explicit checked field, key and constraint specification
inputs: Explicit database schema specification from s2
outputs: Draft schema-definition files and data dictionary without production execution

steps.what: Test the draft structural design with permitted representative or synthetic records and actual user queries and inspect integrity and access cases
inputs: Draft schema and actual test specification
outputs: Actual structural test findings and required design corrections

steps.what: Correct and check the complete final database design and dictionary against actual user requirements, provenance and structural test findings
outputs: Final checked database design package

steps.what: Save the final checked database design package in the same controlled design workspace
outputs: Saved research database design

tasks.design: Use existing database design templates in {DATA_PLATFORM} to generate draft schema files and dictionary text from the scientist's explicit structural specification. The scientist retains requirements, scientific record semantics, testing and the complete final design check before saving the package in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated schema-definition syntax and dictionary formatting can duplicate an already specified structural design.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing schema tools can emit exact definitions from explicit fields, keys and constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Representing actual research records correctly and preserving provenance, integrity and access boundaries.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist understands the records' scientific meaning and what researchers need to retrieve.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated schema and dictionary transcription within research database design.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; research and platform owners approve dictionaries, permitted test data and access design

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: schema design tools can generate structural definitions and dictionary documentation from explicit field and constraint specifications.

assumptions: Actual researchers and data owners supply existing record dictionaries and requirements; s1 checks them and s2 authors structural choices. Missing semantics or keys return to the actual owner.

This design concerns storing and retrieving existing research records, including library metadata where relevant. It generates no biological variants, sequences, experimental procedures or experimental selection recommendations.

s3 replaces manual schema syntax and dictionary transcription; equivalent existing generation earns no new gain. Representative test records are supplied by their actual owner or explicitly authored as synthetic cases in s2 and checked in s4.
No production database creation, data migration, access grant or external deployment is hidden in design; those require the actual platform process and final-version authority.
Illustrative gross saving 20 per 100 task hours, upkeep 3, net 17; same-workspace save earns no gain.
unknowns: Actual schema-tool availability and manual dictionary transcription workload
research_questions: Can the current database design tool generate exact schema and dictionary outputs from explicit structural definitions?

already_counted.description: Elicit requirements, design schema semantics and test and check the complete design package

incremental.description: Maintain schema templates and structural benchmark cases

approvals.approved_version: Complete database design package checked in s5; changes require rechecking and applicable retesting

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured database-design episode with manual structural syntax and dictionary transcription today; scientific requirements, semantic design and full testing retained, upkeep deducted.
